scripts.build:wasm:skip: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('pkg/collision.js') ? (console.log('Skipping WASM build - using pre-built WASM files from pkg/'), 0) : (console.error('ERROR: Pre-built WASM files not found in pkg/ and cannot build (cargo missing)'), 1))"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm:skip && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:full: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
